description: Discussion #22 / issue #20's normative uniqueness rule: (test_case_id, run_id, attempt) MUST be unique across a ResultSet's results[] whenever attempt is present. This fixture has two Results for the same test_case_id sharing the ResultSet's single run_id, both stamped attempt: 1 -- a same-attempt collision, not a legitimate second repetition (which would be attempt: 2). A conforming validator MUST REJECT this document rather than silently accept the duplicate (the gap Discussion #22 was raised to close).
